name: get_active_attack_status
description:
Retrieve active firewall attack data for a project. Covers the last day by default; the optional since value changes the start of the window.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/security/firewall/attack-status --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
